page.layout: One printed page, one column of running text with references and notes set as short lines in the same column. Line numbers (5, 10, 15 ...) stand in the left margin. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature "T" and the note "f) Act." at the foot.

main_text.p: i) Luc.2. verf.7. Peperit igitur filium suum primogeniturn, & fasciis eum inuoluit, reclinauitq3 eum in præsepi: eo quod 5 non erat eis locus in diuerforio.
Matth.2. Christus expositus fuit insidiis Herodis, quas vt effugeret, in Ægyptum est transportatus.
Matth.8. v.20. Vulpes habent lustra, & volucres cœli nidos: filius autem hominis non habet, vbi caput reclinet. Confer Luc. 10 9.verf.58.
2. Cor. 8. v.9. Nostis enim beneficentiam Domini nostri Iesu Christi, eum videlicet propter vos pauperem factum esse, cum esset diues: vt vos illius paupertate ditesceretis.
k) Matth.20.v.28. Filius hominis non venit, vt sibi ministretur, sed vt ministret. 15
Phil.2,v.7.8. Ipse se inaniuit, forma serui acceptâ, similis hominibus factus: & habitu inuentus vt homo, ipse se submisit, factus obediens vsq3 ad mortem, mortem autem crucis.
Hebr.5.v.7.& deinceps. Christus in diebus carnis suæ, deprecationibus & supplicationibus oblatis cum clamore valido & lachrymis, &c. 20
o) Psal.16.v.10. Non es derelicturus animam meam in sepulchro: neq3 expositurus benignum tuum, vt videat corruptionem. Confer Act.2.v.30.31.
Matth.12.v.40. Sicut fuit Ionas in ventre ceti tres dies & tres noctes: ita erit filius hominis in corde terræ tres dies & tres noctes. 30
Eph.4. v.9. Caterum illud Ascendit, quid est nisi quod etiam descenderat prius in infimas partes terræ?

page.notes: Left margin numerals 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are printed line counts beside the text. Those at the far left edge (r, n, h, ı and the like) belong to the neighbouring page and are left out. The mark on the last note reads as "f" but may be another letter; [?] given. The 'q3' and 'vsq3' forms are printed abbreviations (que), kept as printed.
